description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class within a REST API project. The class provides common methods for handling JSON request bodies, creating standard HTTP responses, and retrieving user information from requests. It serves as a base class for specific controllers to extend.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: An abstract base class for API controllers providing common functionalities such as JSON decoding, response creation, and user extraction.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger instance for the controller.

methods.name: getJsonBodyDecoded
methods.description: Decodes the JSON request body into a generic object.

methods.name: getJsonBodyDecodedAsClass
methods.description: Decodes the JSON request body into a specified class instance.

methods.name: getJsonAsClass
methods.description: Maps JSON data into a specified class instance with optional strict null type checking.

methods.name: getJsonBodyDecodedAsArray
methods.description: Decodes the JSON request body into an associative array.

methods.name: createInternalServerErrorResponse
methods.description: Creates a 500 Internal Server Error response.

methods.name: createDeletedResponse
methods.description: Creates a response indicating deletion, typically a 204 No Content.

methods.name: createStatusCreatedResponse
methods.description: Creates a 201 Created response with JSON body.

methods.name: getUserFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts user information from the request attributes and returns a User object.
